jobs.title: Social Comms
jobs.description: Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce. Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that. The Social Comms role : We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment. As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public. You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work. You'd be a great fit if You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious. You understand how LLMs work at an abstract level and the flaws they have. You've run or grown popular social accounts before. You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you. You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about. You can disagree with strangers thoughtfully in public, critics included. You have a feel for which channels matter, and which ones aren't worth our time. You have experience in civic domains, public-good, policy, trust-and-safety, or non-profits. Bonus: you have already published material relevant to AI and its proliferation and risks. jobs.title: Why do you want this new job
jobs.description: No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far: Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years. Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance. Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss. Iâm looking for more challenging work. All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills. About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer. If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job. About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job. Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it. In a nutshell, when you walk into an interview itâs yours to lose. The potential employer is investing their time and resources and would rather have you hired than having to interview other candidates. A

jobs.description: The project compensation rate is $0.55 USD per accepted image. The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS. The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes: • Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings. • Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation. • Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes. To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images. The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review Note: Please use a Gmail address as your primary account when applying for this project. Qualification path No specific education is needed to perform the project task.

jobs.title: Cloud Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Ab sofort Das erwartet dich Wir bauen mit unserem Green-Field-Ansatz eine neue Cloud in unseren deutschen Rechenzentren auf — vollständig selbst gehostet, cloud-native und ohne Abhängigkeit von amerikanischen Hyperscalern. Jeder unserer Kunden erhält ein dediziertes Kubernetes-Cluster auf Basis des SUSE-Stacks (Harvester, RKE2), ausgerollt und verwaltet über Fleet, mit eigenem Tenant-Management. Du bist nicht Betreiber eines fremden Systems, sondern gestaltest die Plattform, auf der unsere Software als SaaS läuft — mit echter Verantwortung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum. Digitale Souveränität ist bei uns kein Versprechen, sondern Betriebsrealität. Auf dieser Plattform laufen die geschäftskritischen Anwendungen von Versicherern und Auftraggebern der öffentlichen Hand. Die Anforderungen an Verfügbarkeit, Informationssicherheit und Nachweisbarkeit sind auf allerhöchsten Level. Hierfür sind unsere Managed Services nach BSI C5 testiert. Das erwartet dich Plattform entwickeln und gestalten Konzeption, Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung der selbst gehosteten Cloud-Plattform (Multi-Cluster, ohne Hyperscaler-Abhängigkeit, volle Kontrolle) Architektur und Design hochverfügbarer Kubernetes-Cluster im SUSE-Stack, inklusive Networking, Storage, Load Balancing und Authentifizierung Design und Weiterentwicklung des Tenant-Konzepts: isolierte Kundenumgebungen, Verantwortung für Architektur und Lifecycle Abstimmung mit der Entwicklung zu performance- und verfügbarkeitsrelevanten Anforderungen an das Cluster- und Tenant-Konzept Weiterentwicklung des Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepts: Ein verteilter In-Memory Ansatz über mehrere Knoten (Schwarmtechnik), der die Echtzeitfähigkeit der Anwendungen im Normalbetrieb sicherstellt Automatisieren und standardisieren GitOps-Workflows über ArgoCD und Fleet — von der Erstauslieferung bis zum Day-2-Betrieb vollständig automatisiert Infrastructure as Code mit Ansible, Terraform oder vergleichbaren Tools; Policy as Code für Sicherheit und Governance CI/CD-Integration und Standardisierung der Deployment-Prozesse Brücke zu den Entwicklungsteams und Kunden Platform Engineering für interne Teams: Aufbau von Self-Service-Fähigkeiten, Definition von Standards, Begleitung des Onboardings Aktive Unterstützung der Entwicklungsteams bei der Migration ihrer Workloads in die Cloud-Plattform Verarbeitung von Erkenntnissen aus dem laufenden Betrieb (Monitoring-Daten, Incidents) zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung von Stabilität, Sicherheit und Performance Das bringst du mit Must-have Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Cloud- oder Platform-Engineering, in Container-Technologien oder Infrastrukturautomatisierung Fundierte Kubernetes Kenntnisse, idealerweise aus dem Betrieb produktiver Multi-Cluster-Umgebungen Erfahrung mit GitOps-Workflows (idealerweise ArgoCD oder Fleet) und Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Ansible, Terraform) Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine und Termine an unseren weiteren Standorten Nice-to-have Erfahrung mit SUSE Stack oder vergleichbaren Kubernetes-Management-Plattformen Kenntnisse in DevSecOps, Policy as Code oder Hochverfügbarkeitskonzepten Erfahrung mit Monitoring-Stacks (z. B. Prometheus, Grafana) Persönlich Systemisches Denken statt Ticket-Fokus, mit Blick fürs Gesamtbild Sicheres Auftreten und Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe mit Entwicklungsteams wie mit Kunden Strukturierte, eigenständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise Erfahrung darin, Themen über Team- und Kundengrenzen hinweg zu steuern Was wir dir bieten Übernimm Verantwortung und nutze deinen Gestaltungsspielraum, um eigene Ideen zu verwirklichen. Arbeite dort, wo Wirkung entsteht: im Office oder direkt beim Kunden. Homeoffice ist die Ausnahme – dafür bieten wir dir flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein Office, in dem man gerne arbeitet und den Tag gemeinsam verbringt. Profitiere von internen und externen Schulungen, die dich fachlich und persönlich weiterbringen.

jobs.title: Product Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Warum LPE Immobilien? Die Hausverwaltung ist der unterschätzteste Beruf Deutschlands: Kein anderer entscheidet so unmittelbar darüber, wie Menschen wohnen. Trotzdem gilt der Hausverwalter bis heute als Buchhalter mit Schlüsselbund. Wir wollen das ändern, und Software ist dafür einer unserer zentralen Hebel. Mit lpeOS bauen wir die Systeme, mit denen wir selbst jeden Tag arbeiten: das Kundenportal für unsere Eigentümer, KI-Agenten, die eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen, und das Verwaltercockpit als Arbeitsumgebung unserer Verwalter. Wir digitalisieren unsere eigenen Prozesse, um die Arbeit unserer Verwalter jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu machen, mit dem Anspruch, die Branche zu revolutionieren. Kaum eine Branche wurde von moderner Software so lange übersehen. Der Abstand zwischen dem, was ist, und dem, was möglich ist, ist riesig, und wir bauen ihn Stück für Stück zu. Du wärst eine der ersten Personen im Produktteam. Features verantwortest du end-to-end: von der Idee über die Gestaltung bis zum Release, bei Bedarf auch ohne Designer an deiner Seite. Unser Stack : TypeScript durchgehend, mit React und Next.js im Frontend und Node im Backend, als Monorepo auf Google Cloud (Infrastructure as Code), dazu Postgres und event-getriebene Prozesse. Du willst verstehen, warum etwas gebaut wird, bevor du es baust. Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf B2-Niveau. Du erfüllst nicht alle Punkte? Bewirb dich trotzdem. jobs.title: Working Student/Intern - Marketing (f/m/d)
jobs.description: At justDice, we create mobile gaming experiences that reward players for their time and engagement. We move quickly, take ownership, and value people who bring ideas, curiosity, and a willingness to challenge how we do things. You’ll work with experienced teammates, solve meaningful problems, and have the freedom to make an impact from day one. At justdice , we’re the European market leader in app discovery and mobile gaming. Reaching millions of users worldwide, we create, acquire, and scale tech products that keep people entertained. We operate with high autonomy, speed, and zero fluff. If you want a corporate environment with endless approval loops, this isn't it. If you want to take ownership, test bold ideas, and jumpstart your career in marketing, welcome home. We’re looking for a high-energy Working Student or Intern (f/m/d) to support our marketing team across Organic Content, Performance Marketing, SEO, and Influencer Marketing. Your Mission Organic & Social Growth: Create fresh, trend-aware content for our social platforms. You know what clicks on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, and you might even feature in our own campaigns. Influencer & Campaign Marketing: Work with the team to manage communication with our influencer agencies; selecting top creators, approving content, evaluating campaign performance, and scaling the channel. App Store & SEO Operations: Assist the team with App Store Optimization (ASO) and Search Engine Optimization (SEO) to make sure our products rank #1. Employer Branding: Partner with the team to shape our homepage messaging, craft engaging brand content, and bring our company culture to life. Performance Marketing: Help set up, track, and optimize paid ad campaigns, blending your creative instincts with sharp analytics. Your Profile Fluent in English & German: Both languages are an absolute must-have (written and spoken). Social Media Native: You live and breathe current trends, memes, and platform formats. Having your own social media channel with a few thousand followers is a huge plus! First Experience: Prior experience from a marketing internship, working student role, or side hustle is a major advantage. Balanced Mindset: You are highly creative, yet analytical enough to look at data and understand what drives performance. Drive & Energy: Proactive, eager to learn, and ready to take ownership from Day 1. Location & Availability: Based in Hamburg or surrounding areas, available for 2.5 days per week (working student) or full-time (internship). Preferred working days: Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Fuel for the Journey: Benefits to Support Your Ambitions Invest in Your Future : Regular feedback and our development program support your growth, helping you expand your skill set and achieve your career goals. Thrive Where You Work : Enjoy the Alster Lake view from our central office with top-notch equipment, fun open spaces, and a large variety of snacks and drinks. Join the Community! Apply now and don't forget to include links to your social media profiles or portfolio! At justDice, we value ownership, honesty, collaboration, and having fun while building something ambitious together. We care about hiring great people, not perfect CVs. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. The problem this role exists to solve is easy to state and hard to do: most technical decisions now get made by builders and the agents they run, not by senior engineers in review, so the standard has to be built into the tooling itself or the gaps show up in what customers touch. Mews is rebuilding hospitality software from the ground up at a genuinely unusual pace, which makes this one of the few staff engineering roles where the leverage you build gets used by everyone around you within weeks.</p> <p>You'll be attached to one tribe, reporting into its Director, and working alongside other staff engineers, staff product managers and staff designers across your division. That means the pace of the role is genuinely high, and we're hiring ahead of that curve rather than catching up after the fact. Day to day, you'll manage a portfolio of standard and mid-complexity clients across multiple pay frequencies: statutory payments, pension auto-enrolment, HMRC filings and payroll journal reconciliation. Understanding of the Data Science / Machine Learning lifecycle and MLOps.

jobs.title: Regional Manager - Paris & Île-de-France
jobs.description: Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun. Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine. Notre ancrage en France est déjà un succès incontestable. Face à une demande qui explose et pour soutenir cette dynamique, nous passons à la vitesse supérieure et recherchons nos prochains leaders sur le marché français. Tu garderas ton propre pipeline de ventes par la suite pour rester connecté(e) à la réalité du terrain. Stratégie & Pilotage : Tu es le/la garant(e) des résultats de la région parisienne. Tu définis la stratégie locale, pilotes les KPIs, mets en place les plans d'action nécessaires et assures un reporting précis à la direction. Ambassadeur/drice Salonkee : Tu représentes notre marque sur le marché parisien, en créant des relations de confiance durables avec les gérants de salons, les grands comptes et les partenaires clés. Ton Profil : Leader inspirant : Tu as une expérience confirmée et réussie dans le management d'équipes commerciales. Tempérament chasseur & "Hands-on" : Tu n'es pas un(e) manager de bureau. Un anglais professionnel est vivement souhaité pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales. jobs.title: Tech Lead Marketplace Experience (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus Connected Growers entwickelt June - die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, B2B Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche. Dafür suchen wir Verstärkung als Tech Lead Marketplace Experience (m/w/d), um nicht nur Software zu entwickeln, sondern ein Team aufzubauen, technische Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team die Zukunft unserer Plattform zu gestalten. Deine Rolle bei June Als Tech Lead Grower Marketplace Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die technische Entwicklung unseres Marketplace und der dazugehörigen Services. Du berichtest direkt an unsere CTO Anna. Du baust einen neuen Engineering Squad von Grund auf auf und übernimmst die technische und fachliche Verantwortung für einen der kommerziell wichtigsten Bereiche von June. Es geht nicht nur darum, gute Software zu bauen: Du setzt technische Richtung, triffst Entscheidungen unter Unsicherheit, entwickelst Menschen, und prägst die Kultur deines Squads. Du sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team dafür, dass wir Funktionen entwickeln, die für unsere Kunden messbaren Mehrwert schaffen. Wir geben dir den Kontext und den Freiraum, den du brauchst, um deinen Bereich eigenständig zu führen. Im Gegenzug erwarten wir, dass du Verantwortung übernimmst, Entscheidungen triffst und auch für ihre Konsequenzen einstehst – in einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem sich Prioritäten verändern und Informationen nicht immer vollständig vorliegen. Du bist kein klassischer People Manager. Du führst über technische Tiefe, Klarheit, Entscheidungen und Vertrauen. Du bleibst hands-on im Code, ohne zum technischen Bottleneck zu werden, triffst Architekturentscheidungen und unterstützt dein Team dabei, gemeinsam hochwertige Software zu entwickeln. Unser Marketplace basiert auf dem Spryker Commerce OS . Du entwickelst ein klares Verständnis dafür, wann wir innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeiten, wann wir erweitern und wann eine individuelle Lösung sinnvoll ist. Dabei behältst du immer die langfristige Wartbarkeit und Erweiterbarkeit unserer Plattform im Blick. Anforderungen Was du mitbringst Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Tech Lead oder Senior Engineer in Web- und E-Commerce-Anwendungen sowie fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit PHP und Spryker Commerce OS und weißt, wann du innerhalb der Spryker-Konventionen arbeitest, erweiterst oder bewusst davon abweichst. Du bringst Erfahrung mit API- bzw. Spec-first-Entwicklung sowie mit AWS-Cloud-Infrastrukturen, modernen Deployment-Prozessen und Monitoring mit. Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Teamaufbau und weißt, worauf es ankommt. Du hast Verständnis, Interesse und Lust an Produktentwicklung (Software) und Teamentwicklung (Menschen). Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, kommunizierst klar, hast hohe Qualitätsansprüche und sprichst fließend Deutsch sowie sehr gutes Englisch. Das wäre ein Plus Gute Kenntnisse in TypeScript. Erfahrung mit ERP-, Warehouse- oder Commerce-Systemen. Erfahrung mit komplexen Order-, Pricing- oder Inventory/Catalogue-Prozessen. Erfahrung in einem Startup oder schnell wachsenden Technologieunternehmen. Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst Du verantwortest Architektur, technische Qualität und Weiterentwicklung des Marketplace und seiner Services. Du baust dein Squad auf, entwickelst deine Teammitglieder weiter und schaffst eine Kultur aus Ownership, Pragmatismus und kontinuierlichem Lernen. Du entwickelst eine klare technische Strategie für den Produktbereich Marketplace Experience und triffst bewusste Entscheidungen darüber, wie wir Spryker einsetzen und erweitern. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Produkt-Team zusammen und übersetzt die Bedürfnisse unserer Käufer und Verkäufer in nachhaltige technische Lösungen.. Du sorgst dafür, dass dein Team Software kontinuierlich, sicher und zuverlässig ausliefert

jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON ENISE - Post doctorat - Modélisation et optimisation de la sphéroïdisation de poudres métalliques par plasma RF
tags: ltds - laboratoire de tribologie et dynamique des systèmes
jobs.description: Le poste est basé à Centrale Lyon ENISE, sur le campus stéphanois, qui accueille plus de 1250 élèves et 160 personnels, dans un environnement exceptionnel aux portes du Pilat. Centrale Lyon ENISE forme des ingénieurs de spécialité Génie mécanique, Génie civil, Génie sensoriel sous statut étudiant (FISE) ou sous statut apprenti (FISA). DESCRIPTIF Contexte scientifique : Dans le cadre d'un projet ANR consacré au traitement et à la fonctionnalisation de poudres métalliques par plasma radiofréquence, le laboratoire souhaite recruter un post-doc pour développer une approche couplant modélisation physique, expérimentation et optimisation des paramètres de procédé. Le travail portera principalement sur la sphéroïdisation de poudres d'AlSi10Mg par plasma RF inductif, réalisée sur une torche TekSphero40 (40 kW). Le procédé vise à transformer des particules initialement irrégulières en particules sphériques adaptées notamment aux procédés de fabrication additive métallique. Le projet s'intéresse à un problème scientifique fortement couplé. L'augmentation de l'énergie apportée aux particules favorise leur fusion et leur sphéroïdisation, mais peut simultanément accentuer l'évaporation du magnésium, la formation de nanoparticules et la coalescence des particules en vol. L'objectif est donc de rechercher un compromis optimal entre plusieurs critères de qualité de la poudre. Verrous scientifiques : La fabrication additive métallique par fusion laser sur lit de poudre (L-PBF) nécessite des poudres très sphériques, coulables et chimiquement homogènes. Le procédé de sphéroïdisation par plasma à couplage inductif radiofréquence (RF) est une voie industrielle intéressante pour répondre à ces besoins. Dans ce procédé, la poudre traverse un plasma d'argon à 10 000 K, fond en vol (~ 5 -150 ms) et se resolidifie en gouttelette sphérique sous l'effet de la tension de surface. La qualité finale des poudres dépend de quatre paramètres opératoires principaux : la puissance du procédé, le débit de poudre, les débits de gaz (central, gaine, porteur), et la position axiale de la sonde d'injection de poudre dans le plasma. Sur la torche TekSphero40 (20-40 kW) et pour l'AlSi10Mg, trois verrous scientifiques sont identifiés et doivent être levés simultanément : • Verrou 1 : Coalescence des particules : les gouttelettes fondues, en raison de leur faible viscosité, fusionnent lors de collisions en vol, provoquant un grossissement non contrôlé de la distribution granulométrique. Ceci a été particulièrement observé dans nos essais sur la sphéroïdisation de AlSi10Mg. Dans la littérature, cet effet a été rapporté sur une poudre de tungstène (Zhu et al. 2017). • Verrou 2 : Évaporation des éléments légers : le magnésium (Tvap = 1091 °C) s'évapore préférentiellement dans le plasma, provoquant un appauvrissement en Mg de l'alliage (perte de la phase durcissante Mg₂Si) et la formation de fumées métalliques. • Verrou 3 : Formation de nanoparticules : les vapeurs métalliques produite dans le plasma conduisent à la condensation en nanoparticules polluantes et parfois, de dépôts satellites sur les grosses particules. Ces trois verrous sont couplés : augmenter la puissance ou le temps de séjour améliore la sphéricité mais aggrave la coalescence et l'évaporation. Le problème est intrinsèquement multi-objectifs et aucune solution "toute faite" n'existe dans la littérature pour cet alliage. MISSION ET ACTIVITES Le post-doc développera un modèle permettant de prédire le comportement des particules dans le plasma en considérant trois phénomènes physiques principaux : • Fusion et sphéroïdisation : établir le bilan énergétique entre le plasma et les particules afin de déterminer les conditions permettant leur fusion complète et leur transformation en particules sphériques. • Évaporation du magnésium : modéliser la perte préférentielle de Mg lorsque les particules atteignent des températures élevées, en reliant température, temps de séjour et cinétique d'évaporation. • Coalescence :

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Entertainment (H/F)
jobs.description: Basés en plein cœur de Paris, nous faisons bouger l’industrie des jeux en ligne. Leader du poker et des paris sportifs en France avec 350 000 joueurs et 600 000 parieurs mensuels, nous sommes présents en Espagne, en Allemagne et bientôt en Italie et au Portugal. Nous offrons à nos joueurs une expérience exceptionnelle, à la fois technique, créative et qualitative. Innovation, unité et appartenance : nos valeurs façonnent une culture d’entreprise multiculturelle et unique.   Et si tu avais un futur dans le jeu ?   Techniquement, Winamax c’est : Un moteur de jeu puissant et innovant : adaptation dynamique de l'offre de jeu, parties de poker hautement configurables, détection de fraude Une architecture distribuée et scalable conçue pour traiter en temps réel les flux de la plateforme Une plateforme modulaire soumise à des contraintes de haute disponibilité et de sécurisation des données, capable de gérer de fortes audiences À PROPOS DU POSTE Au sein de la team Entertainment, tu seras le Tech Lead d’une équipe de neuf développeurs . Tu participeras activement à la conception, au développement et à la mise en production des opérations promotionnelles Winamax, tout en accompagnant l'équipe au quotidien. Ces opérations, liées à nos univers poker et paris sportifs, prennent la forme de mini-jeux et campagnes interactives reposant sur une logique applicative forte (règles, gains, états), développées majoritairement from scratch et exposées à une forte volumétrie d’utilisateurs. En tant que Tech Lead "hands-on", tu auras un rôle hybride : tu garderas les mains dans le code (environ 50% de ton temps) sur les problématiques les plus complexes, tout en endossant le rôle de manager et de référent technique. Tu travailleras dans un environnement pragmatique où la stabilité, la performance et la qualité de livraison sont des enjeux clés.  DESCRIPTIF DU POSTE Management & Leadership : Encadrer, animer et faire grandir une équipe de développeurs Fullstack (suivi régulier, 1-to-1, mentoring, évolution de carrière). Organiser et fluidifier le travail de l'équipe (découpage des tâches, chiffrage, priorisation) en collaboration avec le Product Owner. Diffuser les bonnes pratiques de développement et garantir la qualité du code via des  code reviews . Organiser et fluidifier le travail de l'équipe : découpage des tâches, chiffrage, priorisation et planification des jalons de livraison. Garantir la tenue des délais et la qualité des livrables, anticiper les risques (techniques ou de planning) et proposer des plans de mitigation. Architecture & Développement (Hands-on) : Concevoir et développer les briques applicatives (majoritairement les microservices back-end en Node.js, tout en gardant une vision sur l'intégration front). Implémenter la logique complexe des opérations (règles de jeu, gains, validations) et gérer les problématiques de haute volumétrie. Porter la vision technique de l'équipe : choix d'architecture, structuration des projets, définition des spécifications techniques. Assurer la mise en production et le suivi post-production (stabilité, monitoring, alertes, gestion des incidents). ENVIRONNEMENT & ENJEUX TECHNIQUES Back-end : Node.js (TypeScript non transpilé avec JSDoc). Écosystème Fullstack : capacité à interagir et guider l'équipe sur les enjeux Front-end (React/Vue, animation, intégration web) liés aux mini-jeux. Événementiel : Kafka (consumer groups, reprocessing, gestion des erreurs). API publiques : contrats stables, versioning, performance et backward compatibility. Performance temps réel : faible latence, fort débit, observabilité (logs, métriques). Concurrence & fiabilité : idempotence, gestion des retries, race conditions. Données : MySQL (modélisation, transactions, optimisation des requêtes). Redis / Valkey (cache-aside, cohérence cache / DB, réduction de latence). Architecture : Hexagonale (ports & adapters), forte exigence de testabilité et maintenabilité. PROFIL RECHERCHÉ Issu d'u

jobs.title: SRE Manager
jobs.description: About Us Parity is one of the world's most experienced core blockchain infrastructure companies, having built and pioneered some of the most advanced technologies in the blockchain sector. Parity was founded by Dr. Gavin Wood, co-founder and former CTO of Ethereum, the primary engineer behind the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM), inventor of the Solidity programming language, and primary author of the Ethereum Yellowpaper. People in Our Collective Are Highly motivated to contribute to Parity’s mission and be part of something bigger Excited to work on projects that are groundbreaking and complex Autonomous workers that self-initiate, but also collaborate well with others Taking maximum accountability and having minimum ego at work Comfortable with chaos and adapting to the ever-changing Web3 space Continuously educating themselves about Parity and the wider ecosystem About the Team The SRE team is responsible for the infrastructure that makes the Polkadot platform and technology work: test and production network environments, deployment pipelines, observability, and the systems that developers, node operators, and end-user applications across the ecosystem rely on. This spans the full stack from runtime and parachain development environments through to infrastructure supporting live applications and events. We run environments at different stability tiers, from fast-moving test networks with daily automated updates to production networks with 24/7 on-call coverage. It's a small team, so the role carries broad scope. The Role We're looking for an engineering manager who can lead a team of experienced SRE engineers and raise the standard of what reliability looks like in a blockchain infrastructure context. The team is technically capable. What it needs is someone who can set engineering direction, build the conditions for good work, and think clearly about reliability as a discipline: SLOs, error budgets, blameless postmortems. What We're Looking For Systems thinking. You have a genuine understanding of distributed systems and large-scale infrastructure. You don't need to be the most senior engineer technically, but you need to be credible to people who are. Reliability. You've worked in or led a team that takes SRE seriously. You know what error budgets are actually for, when SLOs are miscalibrated, and how to run postmortems that improve things. Automation. You get uncomfortable when skilled engineers spend time on work a machine could do. You've built teams that automate away the repetitive work rather than just absorbing it. People development. You have a track record of engineers growing under your leadership, ideally some of them moving on to bigger things. Comfort with unusual territory. Blockchain infrastructure has properties that don't map cleanly onto standard cloud operations. You don't need prior Web3 experience, but you shouldn't be put off by it either. Working at Parity Remote-first, with offices in Berlin, Lisbon, and London. Parity is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diversity in our global team and care about everyone in our collective feeling included and welcome. View our Applicant Notice to see how we use your data. Is this position not quite your match? Browse our other open roles. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.description: Company & Role Overview  About Hilo by Aktiia  High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.  We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. jobs.title: Senior Salesforce Developer (Temporary)
jobs.description: For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well. For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you. Angi at a glance: Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021 Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting Angi is seeking a Temporary Senior Salesforce Developer to join our Sales and Care Tooling team. In this role, you will design and implement functionality that supports our Sales and Care organizations, and help integrate our Salesforce instance with a new global, technical platform. You will work closely with seven Salesforce specialists and a Product Manager to deliver against team objectives. Our team works fluently with Visual Studio Code, Git, and SFDX CI/CD, and has recently adopted AI-assisted development to significantly increase output. We deploy to production an average of three times per day. Our guiding philosophy is "Salesforce flows first." Most business features are built by administrators using Flow. Engineers partner with senior administrators to maintain a coherent package architecture and to design and develop custom components where Flow isn't a fit. Technology Stack On the Salesforce side, we follow an unlocked packages strategy across 20+ packages. Our code is built on open-source Apex design pattern frameworks (FFLIB and AT4DX), with high, meaningful Apex test coverage — though we default to Flow wherever possible. While Salesforce is the primary tool for our Sales and Care teams, Angi's core platform runs on services built in Symfony 5.4 (PHP 8.1) and Kotlin, deployed on Kubernetes clusters. What you’ll do Partner with the team to deliver high-priority initiatives integrating our Salesforce instance with Angi's new unified platform in the US market Contribute to, uphold, and help evolve the team's development quality standards and Salesforce best practices Ground your work in the data and context behind key decisions Be an active voice in product and technical discussions Apply your expertise and experience to support the other senior team members as they make and implement critical technical decisions over the coming months Who you are You possess deep knowledge of Salesforce application architecture and software design principles You have 8+ years of commercial experience developing in LWC and Apex, including automated testing You use Visual Studio Code (or similar IDE), Git and AI tooling in your development workflow, and are experienced with Salesforce code deployments using CI/CD tools You are a collaborative communicator and have experience working in agile and lean environments on cross functional teams. You have Platform Developer I & II certifications Nice to have Additional Salesforce core platform certifications (e.g., Service Cloud, Experience Cloud) System Architect or Certified Technical Architect certification Trailhead badges or superbadges (Apex Specialist, Lightning Web Components Specialist) Familiarity with automated testing philosophy: TDD, Apex tests, Jest tests Benefits The salary band for this position ranges from €85,000 - €105,000 (annualized), commensurate with experience and qualifications Hybrid work environment and home office set-up allowance Temporary work from abroad policy Regular team and social events Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. Demonstrated experience in cross-functional collaboration, working with internal teams to deliver complex solutions to sophisticated business customers. jobs.title: Product Manager - Discover
jobs.description: About BlaBlaCar BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely. Your Mission As the Product Manager for the Discover squad, you will focus on the upper funnel of the passenger journey. Your mission is to capture global traffic via SEO and emerging LLM-based search (GEO), ensuring passengers have a seamless experience when they land on our platform. You will build a vision that maximizes conversion from all acquisition channels, prioritizing high-impact projects across our core markets. The Team The Demand Team: The Discover squad is a core team of the Demand pillar, owning the end-to-end passenger experience alongside Search, Booking, Payment, and Post-booking. Your Squad: You will co-lead the Discover squad alongside an Engineering Manager. The squad consists of 6 front-end engineers. Internal Stakeholders: Product Marketing, SEO and Digital Marketing Managers, Product Data, Product Design, and Business leads. Your Responsibilities Shape the Discover strategy & roadmap: Define the Product and Engineering vision for the Discover scope, along with the appropriate KPIs to measure progress. You will take full responsibility for your scope from strategy to execution. Drive top-funnel acquisition: Partner with the Marketing and SEO teams to define and deliver the acquisition roadmap. This includes adapting our architecture for the AI era to ensure our inventory is easily crawlable by LLMs and AI agents. Maximize landing page conversion: Define and deliver a strategy to optimize the landing experience and maximize conversion from all channels. You will leverage AB tests to run experiments and drive our Land-to-Book conversion targets. Navigate cross-functional alignment: Act as the go-to product person for all Discover topics. Communicate the strategy, formalize major decisions, and ensure alignment across Engineering, Marketing, Design, Data, and Business teams. Manage the Busfor platform: Act as the referent Product Manager for Busfor, a standalone brand acquired and owned by BlaBlaCar operating in Eastern Europe Your Qualifications Experience: 3+ years of Product Management. An experience in top-of-funnel acquisition, growth, or SEO is preferred but not required. Problem-Solving: Highly analytical with a proven track record of using A/B testing to deliver fast, incremental impact on conversion rates. Stakeholder Influence: Strong interpersonal skills to navigate cross-functional relationships, gain buy-in, and clearly communicate prioritization decisions. Languages: Full fluency in English is mandatory. If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you’d still be a great fit for this role in your application! What we have to offer 2 to 3 days at the office per week 4 additional weeks on top of legal maternity/paternity leaves 50% healthcare coverage (Alan) Financial support for home office equipment Minimum 25 days holiday per year Local meal plan policy (Swile card) 50% transportation paid (Forfait Mobilité Durable) Free unlimited carpooling & bus rides Interested in joining the ride? Here’s what your hiring journey will look like. A 45-min video-call with Talent Acquisition. A 45-minute video call with the Lead Product Manager. Remote use case exercise, followed by a 45-minute presentation to a cross-functional panel of key stakeholders. 30-minute video call with the CPO for final validation Our hiring process lasts on average 20-25 days and offers usually come within 48 hours. jobs.description: The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning. Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.   Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies. Overview We're looking to hire for our Data side of our AI team at Speechify. This role is responsible for all aspects of data collection to support our model training operations. We are able to build high-quality datasets at petabyte-scale and low cost through a tight integration of infrastructure, engineering, and research work. We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join us. What You'll Do Be scrappy to find new sources of audio data and bring it into our ingestion pipeline Operate and extend the cloud infrastructure for our ingestion pipeline, currently running on GCP and managed with Terraform. Collaborate closely with our Scientists to shift the cost/throughput/quality frontier, delivering richer data at bigger scale and lower cost to power our next-generation models. Collaborate with others on the AI Team and Speechify Leadership to craft the AI Team's dataset roadmap to power Speechify's next-generation consumer and enterprise products. An Ideal Candidate Should Have BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field. 5+ years of industry experience in software development. Proficiency with bash/Python scripting in Linux environments Proficiency in Docker and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts and professional experience with at least one major Cloud Provider (we use GCP) Experience with web crawlers, large-scale data processing workflows is a plus Ability to handle multiple tasks and adapt to changing priorities. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. What we offer A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product. An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle. A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work. An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry. Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture. Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use. Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more. Work in one of the fastest-growing sectors of tech, the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio. The France Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-100,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience. Think you're a good fit for this job?  Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply. And don't forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: As a Forward Deployed Engineer in the customer organisation, you are the technical spearhead of monday.com 's AI transformation motion for our most strategic customers. You will carry a portfolio of 1 to 2 strategic accounts, deeply embedded with C-level and technical teams to architect, build, and ship AI solutions in production, and you will be accountable for the business outcomes those engagements promised, not just the build. This is part of a growing motion, and you will be joining a team that’s already working on active deployments. Please note this is a hybrid position of 3 days/week in our Paris office. About the Role Enterprises don't struggle to access AI capability; they struggle to deploy it. Your job is closing that gap for a small portfolio of monday.com 's highest-value customers. You will advise executives on AI-driven operational change, design and ship the systems that make it real, and feed what you learn back into the product with evidence, not anecdotes. You will work with: monday AI agents, MCP-based integrations into customer systems, vibe apps, and production workflows. You will take these from discovery through architecture, build, rollout, and measurable adoption. This is an autonomous, high-visibility role that shapes both customer outcomes and the future of forward-deployed engineering at monday.com . What You'll Do Strategic transformation. Embed with C-level stakeholders across your accounts to architect end-to-end AI solutions and scalable workflows that solve complex, mission-critical business pains. You own the narrative from pilot to full production rollout. Outcome ownership. Your success metric is the business result the engagement committed to: adoption, workflow throughput, measurable ROI. You define the success criteria with the customer up front and you own getting there. Build and ship. Design sophisticated platform configurations, build monday agents and vibe apps, wire MCP integrations into customer systems, and prototype custom scripts where the platform ends. Your leverage is architecture and judgment; your credibility is that you can build it yourself. Eval-driven product feedback. Instrument your deployments, run evals against real customer workflows, and translate what you find into PRDs and roadmap input that changes what we build. You are a sensor for the product org, with data behind every claim. Cross-functional leadership. Partner with Sales and CS as the technical authority on account strategy. Productize what you learn: patterns, agents, and assets from one account become reusable machinery for the whole motion. What we promise This role has been built with a direct line into the product roadmap, a mandate to productize rather than repeat, and outcome-based success criteria agreed before the build starts. What You Bring 5+ years building applications from scratch using TypeScript/Node.js/React, with full-stack depth Experience leading hands-on projects end-to-end in a production environment, preferably client-facing Background in Solution Architecture or Software Engineering with a strong grasp of AI/LLM systems: agent architectures, MCP or comparable tool-use protocols, evals, and prompt-to-production workflows Experience navigating C-suite relationships and influencing executive decisions in ambiguous environments Track record of turning one-off delivery work into reusable assets, product requirements, or repeatable playbooks Entrepreneurial, fast-moving, and focused on long-term impact over immediate fixes Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Stage - Data Scientist / Data Analyst (H/F)
jobs.description: Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure. Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants. Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements. Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens. Envie d’imaginer la suite de cette histoire à nos côtés ? Ecrivez-nous ! Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) futur(e) Data Scientist / Data Analyst (H/F) pour rejoindre nos équipes à l’occasion d’un stage de 6 mois de fin d’études de M2 à partir de mars 2027. Ce stage est basé à Paris (75).  Intégré(e) au sein du pôle E-commerce et rattaché(e) au Lead Data Science & Analytics, vous accompagnerez l’équipe dans les sujets du quotidien ainsi que dans la construction de projets dédiés. Vous serez amené(e)s à travailler sur les sujets suivants : Data Analyse Vous serez un(e) membre à part entière de l'équipe Data Science & Analytics et participerez activement à son quotidien : Analyses Ad Hoc : Vous mènerez diverses analyses ponctuelles indispensables pour affiner notre compréhension de nos marques, de la performance de nos produits et du comportement de nos client(e)s. Excellence Opérationnelle : Vous contribuerez au développement continu de l'équipe en identifiant les points de friction, en structurant de nouveaux process et en automatisant les tâches récurrentes. Reporting & Communication Métiers: Vous prendrez la responsabilité de plusieurs mises à jour de reportings. Vous serez responsable du maintien de dashboards hebdomadaires, de reportings mensuels, et de l'initiation des communications clés à destination des équipes métiers. Accompagnement Marketing : Vous participerez aux opérations courantes en réalisant des extractions de données ciblées pour nos initiatives marketing. Cela inclut la mise en place de groupes de contrôle rigoureux et la mesure de la performance incrémentale de ces campagnes. Intégration de l'IA : Vous serez amené(e) à utiliser l'IA au quotidien dans vos missions et participerez activement à la définition et au partage des bonnes pratiques quant à son utilisation au sein de l'équipe. Mise en place d’un moteur d'Embeddings Produits (NLP) : Vous serez au cœur du développement d’un socle algorithmique clé : la transformation de descriptions textuelles en représentations vectorielles (embeddings). Ce projet nourrira de multiples initiatives futures. Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie du projet : Data Preprocessing : Nettoyage des données textuelles issues du catalogue, normalisation, et préparation des corpus d'entraînement. Modélisation : Benchmark, sélection fine-tuning des modèles appropriés (Sentence-Transformers, LLMs, etc.). Industrialisation : Le stage ne s’arrête pas au prototype expérimental. Vous participerez activement au déploiement du pipeline dans notre environnement de production via Metaflow. Monitoring : Mise en place de l'automatisation pour la mise à jour des vecteurs lors des nouvelles collections et monitoring de la qualité des embeddings dans le temps. Requirements Vous êtes étudiant(e) en dernière année de formation supérieure (BAC+5) avec une spécialité en Data Science

jobs.title: Recruitment Marketing Specialist
jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond. We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover Seven European markets live 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), offices in London, Mumbai, and Shanghai $40M Series B just closed, $75M raised to date from Atomico, Project A, and Inven Capital, institutional financing from international banks. We are building the world's first and last industrial-grade AI operating system for materials, redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. About the Role We're looking for a Recruitment Marketing Specialist to help us build and strengthen Andercore's employer brand and attract exceptional talent as we continue to grow. You'll sit at the intersection of Talent Acquisition, marketing, and events , with three main areas of responsibility: managing our social media presence, organising recruitment and employer-brand events, and supporting broader Talent Acquisition projects whenever needed. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys creating engaging content, bringing people together, and turning ideas into action. You'll have the opportunity to shape how Andercore is perceived by future employees and help us build a strong talent community as we scale. What You'll Do Social Media & Employer Branding: Manage Andercore's social media presence with a focus on employer branding and recruitment. Plan content, create and coordinate posts, highlight our people and culture, and continuously look for new ways to showcase what it's like to work at Andercore. Events: Organise and coordinate recruitment and employer-brand events, from career fairs and university events to meetups, networking sessions, and internal initiatives. Own the details from planning and logistics through to execution and follow-up. Talent Acquisition Projects: Support the Talent Acquisition team with a variety of projects as needed — from improving candidate communications and recruitment campaigns to developing new sourcing initiatives, talent community activities, and employer-branding materials. Continuous Improvement: Track what works, experiment with new ideas, and use data and feedback to continuously improve our recruitment marketing activities and candidate engagement. Who You Are You have previous experience in recruitment marketing, employer branding, social media, events, Talent Acquisition, or a similar role . You are fluent in English and confident in communicating with different audiences. German proficiency is a bonus, but not a must. You have hands-on experience managing social media accounts and creating or coordinating engaging content. You have experience organising events and are comfortable managing multiple moving parts, deadlines, and stakeholders. jobs.title: Founding Engineer - atmo (Berlin-based / Hybrid)
jobs.description: At atmo , we've built a core AI product at the intersection of agricultural transition and green finance . As an early-stage company moving from first rollout to scale, we're looking for a hands-on Founding Engineer to join our founding team and help build the AI backbone of our product. Over the past year, we've deliberately evolved from a pure data product into an AI-first platform . AI is now central to everything we do - from ingesting messy, real-world agricultural data to unlocking new financing flows for sustainable farming. We're looking for someone who wants to get hands-on: building and managing the AI agents that power the product, and working closely with our CSO to turn science models into shipped features. About atmo atmo is building the infrastructure for financing the transition of agriculture. Agriculture is facing massive pressure to adapt - from climate change and rising input costs to new technologies and changing market requirements. Yet farmers and their financing partners often lack the data, tools and business cases needed to make the right investment decisions. atmo is an AI-powered Agriculture Finance OS that brings farm, climate and financial data together to turn complex agricultural transition investments into clear, bankable business cases. Our platform helps farmers identify profitable transition opportunities, assess ROI and financing needs, access relevant solution providers and generate bank-ready financing reports. For banks and other financial institutions, atmo provides the data and decision intelligence needed to confidently finance the next generation of agricultural investments. We work across the agricultural ecosystem, including farmers, banks, solution providers and food companies, and are already active in Germany, the Netherlands and the UK, with partnerships and pilots across leading financial and agricultural organisations. Founded in Berlin in 2023, atmo is backed by leading investors, accelerators and non-dilutive funding programmes. We are a lean, ambitious team combining deep expertise in agriculture, finance, climate science, AI and B2B SaaS - with the goal of making agricultural transition investable at scale. Tasks What you'll do Build, run and continuously improve the LLM pipelines at the heart of atmo's product - classifying farm records, soil samples and financial statements, extracting structured data from them, and generating bank-ready reports - from prompting and orchestration to evaluation and monitoring Own the platform end-to-end: a Python/FastAPI backend, Next.js web apps and the AWS infrastructure they run on Partner closely with our CSO on the scientific engine, defining the interface between science and product and turning new models into production-ready features Make AI outputs trustworthy: evaluations, guardrails and clear provenance, so every number in a financing case can be traced back to its source Ship fast and iterate constantly, using modern AI tooling to move with a small, high-leverage team Requirements What we're looking for Hands-on builder - you'd rather be in the codebase than in a meeting Strong Python backend depth (FastAPI or similar, SQL, background jobs), comfortable across the stack in TypeScript/Next.js and owning infrastructure on AWS Practical experience running LLM-based systems in production, not just prototypes: structured extraction, evaluation, cost and latency, handling failures gracefully Comfortable working directly with scientific/domain experts, like our CSO, to turn models into shipped features Fast-paced, get-it-done mindset - thrives in ambiguity and on a lean team, and takes ownership of technical decisions, not just tickets Mission-aligned: genuine interest in climate, sustainable agriculture, and green finance Bonus: exposure to fintech, agritech, or applied climate/agricultural science; German helps, as much of our farm data is German Benefits Why atmo Building at atmo means shaping both the technology and the science

jobs.title: Software Developer for ThinkRail (Innovation Hub)
jobs.description: <p>At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started, back in 2000, we have strived to make the strongest, most effective developer tools on earth. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers to grow, discover, and create.</p> <p>ThinkRail is an innovative project within JetBrains' Innovation Hub. Its aim is to develop a declarative programming language tailored to AI-spec-driven development. Our goal is to build an infrastructure that enables the efficient creation of complex systems with AI, while maintaining the trust of users and flexibility in the results.</p> <p>Thinkrail is now open source and in alpha, and we’re entering the next stage of the product’s development: initial market penetration. We’re focused on bringing it into real-world projects and turning it into a robust, production-ready system.&nbsp;To help us get there, we’re looking for a software developer to join the team. You’d be joining at an early stage, with plenty of opportunity to influence the product, tooling, and architecture as they continue to evolve.</p> <p><strong>This will be an exciting opportunity if you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Want to create something new.</li> <li>Care about building trust in AI.</li> <li>Love programming languages.</li> </ul> <p><strong>In this role, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and evolve VS Code and IntelliJ IDEA plugins for ThinkRail.</li> <li>Develop our language server, including analysis, completion, diagnostics, and verification.</li> <li>Improve the evaluator that turns specs into code and catches spec and code drift.</li> <li>Integrate ThinkRail with AI agent frameworks (e.g. Koog, LangGraph, and Spring AI) and protocols like MCP and ACP.</li> </ul> <p><strong>We will be happy to have you on our team if you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Can work effectively in a distributed team.</li> <li>Have strong collaboration skills, are open to diverse perspectives, and support your ideas with sound reasoning.</li> <li>Possess exceptional problem-solving skills and initiative.</li> </ul> <p><strong>We would be especially thrilled if you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Are experienced with developer tools, DSLs, or static analysis.</li> <li>Have hands-on experience working with LSP or editor plugins (for VS Code, IntelliJ IDEA, or similar).</li> <li>Are interested in or experienced with AI agents and how they’re orchestrated in real systems.</li> </ul> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-DNI&nbsp;</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>We are an equal opportunity employer</strong><br><br>We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. You think in unit economics: CAC, payback, LTV/CAC and contribution margin are part of your everyday vocabulary. Confident with tracking, attribution and analytics setups – you fix broken measurement instead of waiting for someone else to. A real creative instinct: you can judge an ad, brief a better one and spot a winning angle before the data fully confirms it. Structured tester: hypothesis, sample size, decision rule, learning written down and shared. Hands-on mentality and high ownership – you make budget calls without needing a committee. This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Search Infrastructure
jobs.description: <h3><strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">The role</span></strong></h3> <p>Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.</p> <p>We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.</p> <p>When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.</p> <p>The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.</p> <p>The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.</p> <p>In your first year, we expect you to set a clear quality bar for our search products that the team builds against, have a real influence on where our index goes next, and bring us a point of view on where search infrastructure is heading.</p> <p>This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. You will work day to day with our search engineering and research teams, with the evaluation team, and with customer success, who bring us quality feedback from real accounts every week. Our search engineers are deeply experienced in large-scale retrieval, and the product team is small, so you will argue your case directly with the people building it. That only works if you have built at this scale yourself.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Strong">Your responsibilities will include:</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li>Set the quality bar and release criteria for search: what good means per use case, and what a change has to clear before it ships. Our evaluation team owns the measurement, and you work closely with them on what to measure and why.</li> <li>Own the depth, latency, and cost tradeoffs across our search products, and make them explicit and defensible.</li> <li>Shape the direction of our index: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what quality bar it has to meet.</li> <li>Build a point of view on where search infrastructure is going as agents, rather than people, become the main consumer, and turn that into a roadmap.</li> <li>Know how we compare to the alternatives customers evaluate, and drive the work that closes the gaps that matter.</li> <li>Work with customer success and directly with customers to understand where our results fall short in real workflows, and turn that into quality priorities.</li> <li>Partner with the data and vertical product owners on what our corpus needs to contain and how results should be shaped per industry.</li> </ul> <p><strong&gt

jobs.title: Senior Match-3 Designer, New Game
jobs.description: We’re looking for a talented and highly experienced Senior Match-3 Designer (internally Game Designer) to join our lovely and ambitious game team and help craft fun, rewarding and memorable puzzle experiences for our cozy mobile game. You’ll own the overall match-3 gameplay experience, helping to define how the puzzle game feels to play while delivering best-in-class levels that strike the right balance of challenge, progression and delight. From core gameplay tuning and mechanic development through to polished, data-informed level iterations, you’ll take ownership of the player experience and continually raise the quality bar. You’ll work closely with game designers, artists, developers and analysts to ensure the match-3 is satisfying, intuitive and rewarding, evolving its mechanics, pacing and feel so that the game’s creative vision and long-term engagement goals come through. You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience. As a senior member of the team, you’ll also help shape our level production strategy, driving quality with both internal development and external partners while contributing to the long-term direction of the game. What You'll Be Doing Design, build and balance exceptional match-3 levels that deliver engaging gameplay across a wide range of player skill levels. Collaborate with developers to tune game feel and match 3 gameplay to be best-in-class Own the design of blockers, boosters and rewards and shape satisfying level progression Use analytics, player feedback and playtesting to continuously refine levels and improve player experience. Work alongside Engineering to improve level design tools, workflows and implementation processes. Partner with Art to ensure levels are visually readable, aesthetically cohesive and support the game’s creative vision. Plan and own Match 3 content production, ensuring a consistent pipeline of high-quality content that supports development milestones and LiveOps. Lead external level design contractors and outsourcing partners by providing clear briefs, regular feedback and quality reviews, ensuring all delivered content meets Treefrog’s standards. Mentor other designers through feedback, knowledge sharing and collaborative problem solving. What You Have Experience shipping successful free-to-play match-3 or puzzle games. Experience designing LiveOps events, seasonal content or limited-time game modes. Strong understanding of player progression, retention, engagement and monetisation in puzzle. Experience improving level editors, pipelines or content creation workflows. Experience leading small feature teams or mentoring designers. Have a deep understanding of the competition and genre trends. Passion for cosy games and creating emotionally engaging player experiences. What We're Looking for A strong sense of ownership, with the ability to drive work forward autonomously. A consistent track record of delivering high-quality work that meets design requirements and project goals. A proactive mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and solve problems. Sound judgement in balancing creative excellence with production efficiency. The ability to lead external partners with clarity, empathy and high standards. A collaborative approach to sharing knowledge, mentoring designers and raising the team’s quality bar. Clear communication skills and the confidence to constructively challenge decisions. A player-first mindset, balanced with an understanding of creative, technical and commercial goals. A commitment to fostering a collaborative, inclusive and positive team culture. jobs.description: Product Lead Location: Ireland / UK - Remote first Type: Full-time, permanent About Kota Kota is reimagining insurance and retirement benefits for the modern workforce. Through our two flagship products, Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance solution, we're making benefits more accessible, valued and global. Today we power benefits for tens of thousands of employees at Europe's most forward-thinking companies, including Carwow, Tines, Zoe and Remote. Founded in 2022, we've raised more than €20M from leading investors such as EQT Ventures, Eurazeo, Northzone and Frontline, as well as founders and executives from Workday, Remote, Personio and OpenAI. The Role We're hiring a Product Lead to own a product area at Kota. You'll set the vision and strategy, make the calls on what gets built, and lead the engineers who build it. Product Leads managing their own engineers is unusual and it's deliberate: one person accountable for the product and the team shipping it. You'll start in Insurances, which powers how employers offer and manage group cover: health, dental, vision, critical illness, life and income protection. It's our most complex area, and the work is turning underwriting and compliance rules into flows an employee can finish in minutes. That won't be the whole of it. Our teams are loosely split between Insurances and Core/Finance, and people work across the problem set. As we add products and move into new countries the areas will change, so we want someone adaptable and opportunistic who'll own whichever part matters most as we grow. The remit is broad with little structure around it, so it suits a high ownership drive. What You'll Do Own the vision and strategy for your area, and make the product calls on what gets built Lead and grow a group of product engineers, coaching them on scope and delivery decisions rather than assigning tickets Shape and lead 6-week Shape Up cycles for new features and provider integrations Simplify insurer onboarding, plan setup, premium management and benefit workflows Translate compliance and underwriting complexity into flows people complete Work across the whole business. Support, success, sales and operations all have a stake in what you own Help shape what the product areas become as we add products and enter new markets Ship fast at a high quality bar, and hold the team to it What We're Looking For Product experience at lead, staff or principal level. Strong senior candidates are in scope if the rest lines up An entrepreneurial streak.
